description: WHEN TO USE: To check credit balance and usage statistics. Call this before lbm_run_scan to confirm the user has enough credits. RETURNS: Current credit balance, credits used this period, credits per scan estimate, and usage breakdown by model and project.

end_date.description: End date ISO 8601 for usage period (required if start_date provided)

start_date.description: Start date ISO 8601 for usage period (optional, default: current month start)

name: lbm_get_usage
